subject: english
stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “He learned that sometimes people struggle not”?
options: They are lazy or careless, but because a problem has not been found yet
It tells children one thing before they even enter: stories are waiting for you
It becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop
People learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「they are lazy or careless, but because a problem has not been found yet」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It tells children one thing before they even enter: stories are waiting for you」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「they are lazy or careless, but because a problem has not been found yet」，答案為「They are lazy or careless, but because a problem has not been found yet」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They are lazy or careless, but because a problem has not been found yet」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
